stories.headline: Chinese tech giants order $35 billion in Nvidia chips
stories.summary: Sources say ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent ordered over 3 million export-compliant Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 cards. Nvidia may fill only 5%–10% because demand exceeds planned production; the companies did not comment.

stories.headline: US orders DeepSeek removed from federal systems
stories.summary: DHS ordered civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and services, citing data-transfer and security risks. The notice states the government's assessment; China's embassy did not immediately comment.

stories.headline: Trump approval falls to 31% before midterms
stories.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found Trump's approval at a record-low 31% and Democrats leading the generic congressional ballot 47%–35%. National generic ballots do not capture district and state dynamics; the voter margin of error was 3 points.

stories.headline: Zelenskiy meets US envoy as relations deteriorate
stories.summary: Zelenskiy is meeting US envoy Steve Witkoff in Oslo to repair strained ties. Kyiv says US missile warnings and satellite support have weakened; Trump says intelligence sharing continues. Norway seeks a more constructive diplomatic path.

stories.headline: France stays calm under curfews after riots
stories.summary: French cities were calm overnight after targeted curfews, but student and yellow-vest groups called new protests for Saturday. About 2,500 people remained in custody; major labor unions had not joined the new protest call.
